name: reports-outside-01-stale-summary-authority
body: Unmitigated. An agent's internal recollection of a lock outranks the written lock, because the written lock was not opened before asserting. Recurred across sittings. Every prior mitigation was a rule the agent agreed to and broke. Only mechanical mitigation counts: the lock lives in a file that must be opened, and recollection is not a permitted source. Same shape as sourceVerified — an agent cannot self-certify.

props.name: recurrence
props.remarks: Sittings where recollection outranked the written lock.
